(a) people possess implicit gender stereotypic beliefs, (b) these beliefs are in self-favoring form, and (c) this is due to the fact that people tend to associate self with positive traits.

the self-concept and how it is related to gender stereotypes.
the role of self in implicit gender stereotypes.
the role of the implicit self-concept in implicit gender stereotypes.

implicit self-concept is the primary source of implicit gender stereotypes.
the sex differences in gender-stereotyping were in service of self-esteem and not the reverse.
the self-concept is a powerful determinant of evaluative gender stereotypes.

implicit gender stereotypes are self-congruent and that the self-concept is implicit.
implicit gender stereotypes are self-favorable because of self-concept.
